subject: Trouble loading shiny application on Amazon ec2, created in my system

messages.author: 90f7eb21bc0ab0e4
messages.subject: Trouble loading shiny application on Amazon ec2, created in my system
parts:
Hi all,

I have created a simple application to view my processed RData file in datatable. I have used packrat to create application package.

First I created application on my system then I uploaded it to Amazon ec2 server's shyny-server directory.

While loading the application using browser I am getting the above error message.

messages.author: 90f7eb21bc0ab0e4
messages.subject: Re: Trouble loading shiny application on Amazon ec2, created in my system

messages.subject: Re: Trouble loading shiny application on Amazon ec2, created in my system
parts:
Wow!

Now it's working.

I followed the following steps in error rectification:
  • I created a new shiny project inside R-studio in my Amazon ec2 server
  • Unselected the git and packrat option
  • Copied my code in new project directory
  • Run the app from inside rstudio. Saved workspace 
  • Copied the app directory to shiny-server directory
  • Opened the app url( ex: http://**************.us-west-2.compute.amazonaws.com:3838/app1/) in browser
  • And it run!
